# MCP tool reference (38 tools)

The exact surface `bin/mcp-server.mjs` serves (stdio JSON-RPC). Registration recipes: [INTEGRATION-MODES.md](../INTEGRATION-MODES.md).

## `ingest`

Compile a source file into the knowledge store (extract → tier-store → embed → graph → verify). Path must be under allowed source roots; wisdom-tier requires curated:true.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string |  |  |
| `title` | string |  |  |
| `scope` | string |  |  |
| `curated` | boolean |  |  |
| `authority` | string |  | origin trust: operator\|stack\|doc\|web (default doc; operator requires curated:true; never raised downstream) |
| `project` | string |  | project slug this entry belongs to (default: this process's MIDMEM_PROJECT; omit/empty = global) |

## `query`

Hybrid (lexical+vector) search of the knowledge store with provenance. Defaults to this agent's scope + shared (and this process's project + global); pass scopes/projects to override.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  |
| `tiers` | array<string> |  |  |
| `scopes` | array<string> |  |  |
| `projects` | array<string> |  | project filter: results from these projects PLUS global entries (default: this process's MIDMEM_PROJECT + global; pass [] for all projects) |
| `functions` | array<string> |  | memory-function filter: working\|episodic\|semantic\|procedural\|prospective |
| `limit` | number |  |  |
| `maxTokens` | number |  |  |
| `includeGraphContext` | boolean |  |  |
| `minAuthority` | string |  | action-risk gate: exclude results below this origin authority (operator\|stack\|doc\|web) |
| `deep` | boolean |  | force the full hybrid pipeline (skip the progressive lexical-first sufficiency gate) |
| `historical` | boolean |  | stored-vs-used read: include archived entries (labelled by status); history reads never renew leases |
| `statuses` | array<string> |  | explicit status set (active\|archived\|deleted); overrides historical |
| `asOf` | string |  | ISO time: only entries that existed then (created_at <= asOf) |
| `bounded` | boolean |  | apply the occupancy policy (per-authority caps, protected operator slots, lineage floor) even without maxTokens |
| `includeWorking` | boolean |  | include working-function (context-assembly) entries, excluded by default |

## `handoff_brief`

Build a memory brief to inject into an agent hand-off (e.g. before spawning Hermes over ACP, which does not share context). Returns {brief} to prepend to the task string. profile: "local" (tight, authoritative, push-only — for small/local models) or "frontier" (richer, provenance+ids, push+pull — for cloud models).

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes |  |
| `profile` | string |  |  |
| `scopes` | array<string> |  |  |
| `tiers` | array<string> |  |  |
| `projects` | array<string> |  | project filter: results from these projects PLUS global entries (default: this process's MIDMEM_PROJECT + global; pass [] for all projects) |

## `remember`

Store a memory entry (tier default: memory; wisdom requires curated:true). scope defaults to this agent; pass "shared" to publish to the commons. project tags the body of work (default MIDMEM_PROJECT; wisdom promotion lifts it to global).

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string |  |  |
| `tier` | string |  |  |
| `scope` | string |  |  |
| `project` | string |  | project slug this entry belongs to (default: this process's MIDMEM_PROJECT; omit/empty = global) |
| `curated` | boolean |  |  |
| `memFunction` | string |  | memory function axis: working\|episodic\|semantic\|procedural\|prospective (default derived from type) |
| `authority` | string |  | origin trust: operator\|stack\|doc\|web (default stack; operator requires curated:true) |

## `forget`

Remove a memory entry (soft by default; hard requires force:true). Dependency-aware: claims this entry sourced are archived and concept nodes it alone supported are flagged for review (returned as `cascade`; see audit.orphanedConcepts).

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entryId` | string | yes |  |
| `soft` | boolean |  |  |
| `force` | boolean |  |  |

## `prospective_add`

Record a prospective-memory intent — something that must become actionable later. trigger: {type:"date", value:"<ISO>"} or {type:"event", value:"<name>"}. MidMem RECORDS intents; it never fires them — schedule execution in cron (the system of record for time) and poll prospective_due from there.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intent` | string | yes |  |
| `trigger` | object | yes |  |
| `context` | string |  |  |
| `scope` | string |  |  |
| `project` | string |  | project slug this entry belongs to (default: this process's MIDMEM_PROJECT; omit/empty = global) |

## `prospective_due`

Pending intents whose trigger has fired: date triggers ≤ now (or a supplied now), plus event triggers matching the supplied event name. Deterministic read surface for schedulers/hooks; returns intents, acts on nothing.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `now` | string |  |  |
| `event` | string |  |  |

## `prospective_resolve`

Close out a prospective intent: outcome completed | cancelled. Archives the entry but keeps it as history.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entryId` | string | yes |  |
| `outcome` | string |  |  |

## `export_knowledge`

Write the deterministic knowledge snapshot (entries/claims/nodes/edges/sources as stable-byte JSONL, no vectors) to the configured export path — commit it to give the knowledge product git revision history. Also refreshed automatically by the forced/daily maintain.

_No arguments._

## `reembed_fallback`

Repair vectors written while the embedder was down: entries whose vector is a fallback-hash placeholder are re-embedded in place with the real model, oldest first (bounded by limit; since narrows to an ISO time). Self-gating — if the embedder is still offline nothing is touched; if it drops mid-run the pass stops. dryRun counts candidates. Run after an embedder outage (audit/brief show fallbackVectors).

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | number |  |  |
| `since` | string |  |  |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  |  |

## `forget_entries`

Bulk soft-forget entries by selector. A CONTENT selector is REQUIRED (ids: exact entry ids, match: regex on content, or opaque: work events labeled with bare machine identifiers / captured prompt boilerplate); scope/types/olderThanDays only narrow the selection and cannot select alone. Soft-only and reversible until retention prunes; preview with dryRun:true first.

| `dryRun` | boolean |  |  |

## `forget_nodes`

Bulk HARD-delete graph nodes by selector; every edge touching a deleted node is cascaded so nothing dangles. A selector is REQUIRED (ids: exact node ids, match: regex on label, or opaque: machine-identifier labels); types only narrows and cannot select alone. Irreversible — preview with dryRun:true first. For task nodes prefer close_tasks (status→done) unless the node itself is junk.

| `dryRun` | boolean |  |  |

## `project`

Project state.db to the Obsidian vault. Unchanged pages are hash-skipped (the vault is on a network share); force:true rewrites every page — use after restoring or hand-clearing the share.

|---|---|---|---|

## `maintain`

Run the lifecycle pass now (decay sweep + usage-earned promotion + vault reprojection). Normally automatic — runs opportunistically on query/ingest/remember and via the daily timer; force:true bypasses the hourly throttle.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `force` | boolean |  |  |

## `proactive_recall`

Trigger-less pre-turn recall: run the budgeted hybrid search on a raw user message and return {inject} ONLY if results clear the relevance threshold (else inject:null). Call this from a pre-turn hook to surface stored knowledge without the model spending a tool-call cycle. Records retrieval only for surfaced items.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | string | yes |  |
| `minScore` | number |  |  |
| `maxTokens` | number |  |  |
| `scopes` | array<string> |  |  |
| `projects` | array<string> |  | project filter: results from these projects PLUS global entries (default: this process's MIDMEM_PROJECT + global; pass [] for all projects) |

## `record_work`

Record a work-memory event (Brain-style "memory about work"): kind = task_attempt|source_used|dead_end|correction|artifact|decision. Call at task boundaries to track ongoing requests, what worked/failed, corrections, and produced artifacts. Stored as a provenance-linked, categorized entry + typed graph edges; recallable by both stacks.

## `list_tasks`

List ongoing requests — work-memory task nodes not yet marked done (status != done).

_No arguments._

## `close_tasks`

Bulk-close open task nodes (status → done). Task nodes are never deleted by design — closing is how you clear the ongoing-requests list, and entries/edges are preserved. AT LEAST ONE selector is required (they are OR-ed) so a bare call cannot clear the board: tasks (exact labels), match (regex), opaque (bare session UUIDs / timestamped file ids / hex digests that are not real requests), olderThanDays. Preview with dryRun:true before running for real.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tasks` | array<string> |  |  |
| `match` | string |  |  |
| `opaque` | boolean |  |  |
| `olderThanDays` | number |  |  |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  |  |

## `claims`

Search atomic claims. mode "current" (default) returns only the freshest non-superseded/contradicted claim(s) — use to get the right CURRENT fact after updates; mode "all" searches every status.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  |
| `mode` | string |  |  |
| `limit` | number |  |  |

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `oldId` | string | yes |  |
| `content` | string | yes |  |

## `claim_contradictions`

Deterministic contradiction candidates among live claims (pairs sharing tokens but exactly one negated). Review candidates; does not auto-mutate.

|---|---|---|---|
| `minShared` | number |  |  |

## `claims_deferred`

The TARL pending ledger: claims parked status=deferred (write-path contradiction or explicit defer) awaiting judgment, oldest first. Deferred claims are invisible to current-claim retrieval until resolved.

_No arguments._

## `claim_defer`

Park a live claim as deferred (pending judgment) instead of leaving it active — for uncertain or conflicting evidence that should not yet count as durable truth.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claimId` | string | yes |  |
| `reason` | string |  |  |

## `claim_resolve`

Resolve a deferred claim by judgment: action "accept" (→ active) or "reject" (→ archived, kept as ledger history). Never automatic.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claimId` | string | yes |  |
| `action` | string | yes |  |

## `query_probes`

PMMC expected-query probes: compile the likely future query for each recently-active entry (concept names / leading tokens), persist the probe set, and verify each probe surfaces its entry via lexical retrieval. A miss = a plausible future query would not find its evidence. Report-only; also runs on forced/daily maintain.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sampleSize` | number |  |  |
| `topK` | number |  |  |

## `claim_validity`

A claim's PGMem validity window: firstObserved/lastObserved, corroboration supportCount, contradicting-evidence claim ids, and a currentlyValid verdict. Evidence-linked durable claims instead of bare assertions.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claimId` | string | yes |  |

## `consistency_check`

Global memory-consistency check (state-level, report-only): cross-claim contradictions among live claims, dangling supersede chains, and deferred claims aging past their review window. Runs automatically on the forced/daily maintain; call for an on-demand verdict.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minShared` | number |  |  |
| `deferAgeDays` | number |  |  |

## `stale_paths_clear`

Clear reviewed HiGram stale-path flags (set on concept nodes + their community parents when a claim touching them was superseded). ids required — review via audit.stalePaths first; clearing is the judgment that the dependency path was checked.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | array<string> | yes |  |

## `refresh_concepts`

P5: (re)build the concept graph — embed concept nodes (bounded) + recompute communities. Normally runs in the daily/forced maintenance pass; call to refresh on demand.

|---|---|---|---|

## `concept_merge`

Curated concept merge: fold near-duplicate concept fromLabel into toLabel (e.g. "AI inference costs" into "inference costs"). The variant label is kept as an alias so retrieval treats them as one concept. Use audit's dupeConcepts list for candidates; trivial case/plural variants dedupe automatically.

| arg | type | required | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fromLabel` | string | yes |  |
| `toLabel` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string |  |  |
